senses.gloss: m. (sub. קצה) the oblate part of the breast around the nipple.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Niddah 5:8">Nidd. V, 8</cite> <he>משישחיר הפ׳</he> (Bab. ed. 47ᵃ <he>הפיטומות</he>, corr. acc.) when the surroundings of the nipple begin to grow dark.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Terumot 9:1:14">Y. Ter. IX, 46ᵈ</cite> top; X, beg. 47ᵃ <he>העביר פִּטּוֹמְתּוֹ וכ׳</he> if the upper part of it has been removed, it is considered as if cut in pieces.—V. <cite ref="Q00629"><he>פִּיטְמָה</he></cite>.
